artworks.title: A Tired Woman with Two Children
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: an adult seated and a child standing beside them. The adult is draped in a cloak covering their head and shoulders. Their eyes are closed, and their expression appears gentle. The child is wearing a one-piece outfit and is leaning slightly forward. Next to the child is a small animal. Objects and containers are to the left side of the adult. The setting has simple furnishings with wooden surfaces and shadowed walls. The image has a vintage appearance with sketch-like qualities in monochromatic tones.

artworks.title: The Reading
artworks.description: The image shows two people sitting side by side, facing each other. One person is seen in profile, while the other has their back mostly turned. The person in profile has delicate facial features and wears a high-necked garment with long sleeves and their hair styled up with a dark floral accessory. The other person's face is not visible, and they have short hair or an updo. The person in profile is dressed in an elaborate flowing dress, while the other individual wears a simpler outfit with a shawl-like garment over their shoulders. The background features lightly sketched indoor elements, and the image is in a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: A Prayer for Grandpapa
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays four figures in a domestic setting. On the left, a man with a full beard and curly hair sits with arms crossed. A woman kneels beside him on the right, holding a small child. Another woman leans over a ledge behind the seated man. Domestic items are on a shelf, and a dog lies on the floor. The background has a textured surface with hanging objects.

artworks.title: The Little Preacher
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures engaged in a scene. Two women are seated on the floor in the foreground, one reaching out with her hand, while a child or baby lies in front of them. The faces of the individuals are illuminated, showcasing delicate facial features and soft expressions. The women have loosely styled hair and wear draped garments. Another figure, a small child, stands with arms outstretched on a surface, while one of the women nearby leans on the surface and gazes upward. The background is nondescript, emphasizing the interaction among the characters in the foreground. Loose objects such as a plate are scattered on the floor, adding to the lively nature of the composition.

artworks.title: Visit to the Nurse
artworks.medium: gray wash and watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing on the left side, facing slightly towards the left with one hand outstretched towards a child standing next to her. A dog is also present. The woman is wearing a long dress and a hat. On the right side, multiple people are gathered around a bed. Two women are seated on the bed, one holding a baby. Another child and an adult male are leaning on the bed, while another figure stands in the background holding a child. The background appears to be indoors, with a large piece of furniture casting shadows.

artworks.title: Mrs. Charles Badham
artworks.description: This drawing features a seated woman, her body turned to the right and her head facing us. Her hands are in her lap, holding an object resembling a book. The woman has dark curly hair styled under a lace-adorned bonnet. She has deep-set eyes, thin eyebrows, and a small mouth. The woman's face and neck are drawn in detail, but her clothes and accessories are roughly sketched. She wears a dark dress under a shawl with patterns and tassels that covers her shoulders and arms. In the background, there is a faint sketch of a scene with architectural structures, including an obelisk and steps leading to a building with domes or towers.

artworks.title: Pea Harvesters [recto]
artworks.medium: conté crayon and transparent and opaque watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five people. Two individuals are seated or crouched on the ground. One person is wearing a hat with colorful stripes and a light short-sleeved shirt, and the other is wearing a headscarf and a purple garment. The standing person in the center wears a blue dress with a lighter blue apron and has a red scarf tied around the head. To the right is an outline sketch of a person. Faces are not detailed, with minimal depiction of facial features. The background shows a faintly sketched person in a bent over position. The setting appears to be outdoors, perhaps a field or garden. No visible jewelry or objects are being held apart from the foliage in the hands of the central figure.

artworks.title: The Artist's Son Georges [verso]
artworks.medium: transparent and opaque watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a child facing forward, positioned slightly to the left. The child's facial features are delicately drawn with a slightly somber expression. They have large blue eyes, a rosy complexion, and straight, shoulder-length brown hair. The child is wearing light pastel-colored clothing and a scarf or cloak around the neck. The background is undefined, with a vague sketch of an object on the left side and the rest filled with muted colors, highlighting the child.

artworks.title: Montmorency Road
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a rural scene. The point of view presents a path curving away from us and extending into the distance, flanked by fields. The horizon is marked by a line of trees. The sketch uses light pencil work with faint shading and outline. Close to us, a figure with an animal walks along the path. Sparse details on the left show fields, while to the right, a tree and fence posts create a boundary. The color palette is monochromatic, using natural tones and shadows of pencil on paper.

artworks.title: Man Wearing a Cloak [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a person standing with their body slightly angled to the side and their head facing forward. They have wavy, medium-length hair and are wearing long, flowing clothing that covers them from neck to feet. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the sketch. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Man Wearing a Cloak [verso]
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person standing in a slight three-quarter view position with their body turned to the left. The individual has a rounded face with indistinct facial features drawn with light and shadow techniques, and short, wavy hair. The person is draped in long, flowing garments, possibly a cloak or a large robe, which adds a sense of volume and movement to the figure. The attire seems to consist of a layered outfit that reaches down to the person's ankles, and they are wearing simple footwear. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background is plain and minimalist, emphasizing the sketch's focus on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Laundress Carrying Linen
artworks.description: The image features two figures from the waist up, depicted in expressive sketches. The person on the left is leaning back, looking at the other figure. They have a bun hairstyle and wear a long-sleeved dress. The figure on the right has their back partially facing the viewer, also looking towards the left. They have their hair tied back and wear a dress with billowing sleeves. The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Girlhood
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two figures seen from the back. Both figures are shown from the waist up sitting side by side, slightly turned, facing away from the viewer. The two individuals have long, flowing hair and are wearing hats — the figure on the left has a broad-brimmed hat while the one on the right wears a hat adorned with a decorative feature. The clothing of both figures seems to be loose-fitting with draped sleeves and full skirts, drawn with flowing lines. There are no visible facial features due to their orientation. The sketch is on a simple brown paper background with no additional elements or scenery around them.

artworks.title: Study of the "Ecorché" [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of muscular forms. It features curved lines sketching muscular shapes, potentially resembling a flexed arm or anatomical study. The lines are done in a loose, sketchy manner focusing on contours and bulges typical of musculature. Most of the drawing is in the upper portion of the paper, leaving space below bare, emphasizing the simplicity and spontaneity of the sketch. The drawing captures a dynamic sense of movement and energy within the abstract forms.

artworks.title: Father of the Artist [verso]
artworks.description: In the sketch, there are three individuals depicted. The main person is seated, shown from the torso upward, leaning against a structure resembling a rail. They wear loose-fitting clothing and a cap. Two other figures wearing caps are depicted below. One person appears to be holding a newspaper, partially covering their face. The sketch uses minimal outlines without detailed features, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Mont Sainte-Victoire [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is low in the composition. Loose tree sketches are visible along the horizon line. The artist used watercolor with soft strokes to suggest forms. The color palette includes greens, blues, and beige with hints of purple and blue.

artworks.title: Bedpost [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling and curved lines forming abstract shapes resembling architectural elements. There is a vertical structure resembling a pillar with a scroll-like capital. The lines are fluid and sketch-like with hints of watercolor in blue and green. The overall composition evokes an incomplete architectural sketch blending column form with artistic expression.

artworks.title: Landscape at Pont-Aven
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on brown textured wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a high horizon line featuring trees and a thatched-roof building. The house is on the right, surrounded by sparse trees and simple vegetation. The style is sketch-like with expressive lines depicting movement in the foliage. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the rustic feel. The foreground is empty, giving focus to the details in the distance and conveying a sense of openness and tranquility.

artworks.title: Parau No Te Varau Ino (left); Tahitian Legend (right)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, gray wash, and black chalk on J. Whatman paper
artworks.description: The image shows two side-by-side sketches. On the left side, there is a full-body depiction of a standing figure looking slightly to the right with long, dark hair. The facial features are minimally detailed with a calm expression, one hand raised to the face, and the other resting on the abdomen. The background is lightly textured with another sketched figure beside the main subject. On the right side, two figures are shown. The foreground figure is seen from behind with curly hair, holding onto the side of a canoe in water. In the background, another figure sits in the canoe facing the water. The scenery suggests a water setting with small ripples and distant hills or land formations on the horizon.

artworks.title: Tahitian Heads
artworks.description: The image shows three sketches of individuals, each depicted from shoulders up. The top left figure has voluminous hair with a curling strand. The top right figure has closely styled hair. The lower figure has dark, wide hair. The sketches focus on outlines, basic shading, and lack clothing or jewelry details. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Geese; Girls in Bonnets, Geese [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of sketches of birds and figures. The drawing is a collection of quick, loose sketches spread across two panels. On the left panel, various outlines and partial shapes of birds are scattered across the page. Their forms are outlined with simple, fluid pencil strokes capturing different poses. The right panel contains sketched figures wearing wide-brimmed hats with basic outlines and suggested features. Additional avian sketches appear on this side as well, interspersed with the figures. The sketches are light and spontaneous, suggesting they may be studies or preliminary drawings capturing movement and posture.

artworks.title: Trees; Sketch of Breton Boy [verso]
artworks.description: The image depicts two panels with scribbled designs. The left panel shows a person's head and upper body facing left with vague features. The hair is textured with short strokes. The right panel shows a figure in a seated posture with minimal facial features. The figure wears a hat with a wide brim and loosely sketched clothing. The background is blank, emphasizing the shadowed forms and abstract shapes within the drawings.

artworks.title: Monkey and Cottage; Little Breton Boy [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite and crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is an image of two separate sketches side by side. On the left, there is a sketch of a monkey's head and a rough outline of a house with a chimney. On the right, there is a more detailed drawing of a figure possibly sitting, with their head slightly ducked and hands positioned in front, depicted with a colored hat and clothes. The drawing on the right is rendered in a sketchy, loose style with some colored accents.

artworks.title: Woman with Cow, and Goose; Counterproof [verso]
artworks.description: The image depicts faint, sketchy lines grouped on the right side, forming an abstract arrangement. The lines suggest the outline of a human figure seen from the back near an indistinct object that could represent an animal. On the left, more lines form a vertical pattern resembling plant stems or reeds. Above, there is a vague outline resembling the head of a horned animal. The abstract lines allow viewers to connect to familiar forms and interpret the image as they see fit.
